newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market very slow at $68-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market very slow at $68-USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow. Slaughter steers and heifers steady in a very limited test. Inquiry and demand very light.
Sales confirmed on 100 slaughter steers and 1,000 slaughter heifers Tuesday. Week to date 5,500 including 4,000 head or about 73% previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - few mostly Select, few Choice 1200-1250 lbs 68.00. Slaughter heifers - mostly Select, few Choice, few with end of heiferettes 1075-1150 lbs 68.00.
Wk to date - 5,500 last week - 88,200 last year - 18,300
